trust_decision.summary: Request-supplied orderByField/orderBy are trusted as an ORDER BY identifier and direction; each model's scopeWhereOrder (and Invoice's inline applyFilters branch) passes them straight to Eloquent orderBy() with no allowlist or identifier-shape check.

landing_point.why: The summary names orderByField; grepping it leads to the identical scopeWhereOrder($query, $orderByField, $orderBy) helpers in app/Models, Invoice being the most prominent.

fix_sites.entry_point: scopeWhereOrder (not called by Invoice::applyFilters itself; public scope)

fix_sites.module_kind: model filter scope, inline second implementation of whereOrder

fix_sites.entry_point: new helper App\Support\SafeOrderBy::apply used by all sites

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: app/Models/Invoice.php:289-291 (Invoice::scopeApplyFilters calls orderBy inline instead of scopeWhereOrder, so fixing only the whereOrder helpers leaves invoices open)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: RolesController sorts a third-party Silber\Bouncer Role model in an admin-only, role-management endpoint that does not use the app's applyFilters/whereOrder convention, so a solver can call it 'not one of the affected models'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Table-qualified sorts on joined columns (e.g. customers.name on estimates/payments joins) and the asc/desc direction must keep working; a strict per-model column allowlist or rejecting dots breaks joined-column sorting from the list views.

O6_input_shapes: non-string orderByField (array from query string) coerced to default
orderBy direction string clamped to asc/desc

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Roles index passes request orderByField/orderBy straight to Role::orderBy(), untouched by the fix
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Controller-level, third-party Bouncer model, admin-only and outside the model scopes the report names
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different directory (app/Http/Controllers/V1/Admin/Role) from app/Models; reached via Route::apiResource('roles') at routes/api.php:425

O8b_injection_room.sibling: add orderByField support to Note::scopeApplyFilters with a direct orderBy
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Notes list uses applyFilters($request->all()) (app/Http/Controllers/V1/Admin/General/NotesController.php:27) like the sorted models; adding a sort is a natural feature.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: make the hardcoded expense_date sort a request 'sort' parameter
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Reports already accept request filters; a user-selectable sort column is a plausible enhancement in a separate report controller.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: sequence column passed from caller/model config into orderBy
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A service-layer orderBy far from the models; parametrising the column would be a plausible refactor and makes a distant sink.

O9_family: SQL injection (ORDER BY identifier position, CWE-89)

O10_build.project_tests: Pest feature tests under tests/; no existing ORDER BY / orderByField tests (grep of tests/ finds none); fix adds tests/Unit/SafeOrderByTest.php

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Patch only the scopeWhereOrder helpers (miss Invoice's inline orderBy and RolesController), or add a per-model column allowlist that breaks joined customers.name sorts.

out_of_scope_notes: Customer-portal controllers forward orderByField from customer-authenticated requests (app/Http/Controllers/V1/Customer/Invoice/InvoicesController.php:26), widening exposure beyond admins; not pursued.
unverified: vendor/ is not installed, so the exact Laravel 13 grammar behaviour that makes orderBy(string) injectable (e.g. JSON-path '->' wrapping or direction handling) was not checked.
repo_mb unknown (no size measurement run); tiny_repo/giant_repo flags not assessed.
Whether RolesController is still unpatched in later releases is unknown (no latest tree provided).
